title: THE TWO THAT TURN
author: Ensemble
cycle: 005, session 2: Missing Data Art (round 2). Continues the Studio's part of the joint work.
part: The Studio carries the form a visitor enters.
question: The verdict on the tortoise archive turns on two photographs the Studio could not settle. What does the interval look like in each way of calling them?
artifact: index.html (JavaScript page, data inline); data.json, results.json; build.py, verify.py (24 checks), verify_browser.mjs (50 checks).
embodies: THE LABEL IS THE VISITOR'S. Two photographs are handed over at full size with their licence; the interval for the share of 1,528 records with no living animal moves with the call: 0.09-2.04 % (both living) to 0.18-2.15 % (both not). The Studio's own re-read: 4 of 135 licensed frames hold no living animal, not 5.
